items.title: Closures of disjoint open subsets of an extremally disconnected space are disjoint
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in an extremally disconnected space the closures of two disjoint open subsets are disjoint (author lemma at source lines 5465-5470, label lemma-intersection-empty). The proof (source lines 5472-5478) uses openness of the closure of the one subset to empty the intersection with the other and repeats the argument for the intersection of the two closures (proof lines 5472-5477). The two applications of the closure characterisation are the content. H2.
